title: AutoGen list numbering
note: Saving a rule creates or updates one numbering flow for the site collection. The flow runs every minute, reads the active rows in AutoGenFlowConfiguration, and writes a blank number on each related list. The app uses the environment and SharePoint connection the admin selects. API access is Microsoft Flow Service Flows.Read.All and Flows.Manage.All. The definition is built by src/services/siteFlow.ts.
